subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `lint-wiki` or `lint-rollups`, docgate shall verify the class's metadata header rows are present and well-formed (wiki: In one line, Relevant-when, Authority, Sources, Last reviewed; rollups: In one line, Relevant-when, Authority, Update rule, Seeded).
fit_criterion: missing-row and malformed-date fixtures red; real corpus green
